name: kamkam
description: KAMKAM — social media + creator gifts + ledger-backed wallet. Next.js frontend, Supabase backend.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix supabase/tests && npm install --prefix supabase/seed
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm run test:api && npm run test:routes
scripts.local:db: npm install --prefix database && npm start --prefix database
scripts.legacy:dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
